pitch.subject: Stop stock chaos at Al Futtaim Logistics & Warehousing - ERPNext for Warehouses
pitch.html:
Fix Your Warehouse Stock Chaos with ERPNext

Hi,

I noticed Al Futtaim Logistics & Warehousing. Most warehouses in UAE still manage stock, purchases, and sales across WhatsApp, Excel, and disconnected systems - leading to stockouts, overstock, and lost revenue.

ERPNext solves this end-to-end:

  • Real-time Inventory - Know stock levels across all warehouses instantly
  • Purchase & Sales Orders - Convert WhatsApp orders to proper POs/SOs
  • Goods Receipt & Delivery Notes - Track every movement with full audit trail
  • Batch/Serial & Expiry Tracking - Critical for regulated goods
  • Barcode Scanning - Speed up picking, packing & receiving
  • Multi-Warehouse & Transfers - Manage stock between locations
  • Low Stock Alerts & Reorder Rules - Never run out again
  • Reports & Dashboards - Real-time visibility of your business

Implementation: 2-4 weeks, tailored to your warehouse workflow. No bloat, no per-user chaos.
